subject: Staging-to-Prod sequence and enablement - RFI
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Staging-to-Prod sequence and enablement - RFI

Team —

We need to lock down the sequence and ownership for the upcoming staging->prod cutover for runtime-v2. Key ask: confirm the target production cutover window, who owns the playbook steps, and whether any known exceptions (3rd-party or config flags) need escalation.

Proposed constraints:
- Cutover weekend: Sat 2026-08-22 02:00–08:00 UTC (primary window) with a fallback on Sun 2026-08-23 same window
- Canary wave plan attached (rollout-waves.csv) — suggested waves: 5%, 25%, 50%, 100% over 12 hours
- Staging freeze: 2026-08-19 00:00 UTC (no schema/model changes after this)

Questions for each of you:
- Monica: can infra guarantee no rolling restarts beyond the planned GPU pool drain during waves? Any known dependency blockers?
- Ethan: doc & enablement lead — can you own the playbook and training slots? I've attached a draft playbook (pdf) and a doc-owners tracker xlsx.
- Grace: CS — do we need customer blackout dates for onboarding waves and do you have a prioritized recontact list?

Please reply with ownership + blockers by EOD Wednesday 2026-08-12 so I can surface to PM and Eng leaders.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Program Manager, Launch Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: rollout-waves.csv, staging-cutover-playbook-v0.9.pdf, doc-owners-tracker.xlsx)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staging-to-Prod sequence and enablement - RFI

Jordan,

Thanks — quick status from infra/ops side:

- We can support the primary weekend window (2026-08-22 02:00–08:00 UTC). We'll need a 30-min pre-cutover health check and a 1-hour recovery reserve after each wave.
- Known constraint: the embeddings cache service (3rd-party cache) has a TTL edge-case that can cause ~30s cold-start latency for a small percentage of requests after a model swap. Ops is investigating a mitigation but we should include an exception step in the playbook that toggles a short-lived fallback routing policy.
- No planned rolling restarts aside from the GPU node drain we schedule for kernel swaps, but that increases tail latency risk for long-running requests. Recommend limiting in-flight long-context requests during waves and enabling shorter request timeouts.

Blockers / asks for other teams:
- We need a doc entry that lists request-timeout recommended values per route (Ethan)
- If CS plans to contact customers ahead of their wave, provide a list so ops can prioritize escalation channels

I'll take the infra checklist in the playbook and add an "exceptions" appendix for the embeddings cache and KMS key rotation.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Release Engineering, Redwood Inference
(attachment referenced: staging-cutover-playbook-v0.9.pdf - will add appendix)

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staging-to-Prod sequence and enablement - RFI

Folks —

I can own the playbook doc and the enablement runbook. Quick notes:

- I've assigned owners in the doc-owners-tracker.xlsx (sheet: Owners). Primary owners: Runtime Ops (Monica) for infra checks, Docs (me) for playbook content, CS (Grace) for customer comms.
- Training: I can schedule two 45-minute enablement sessions (internal) on 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-19 at 1600 UTC. Will prepare a short slide deck and a 1-page troubleshooting cheat sheet.
- Docs ask: please provide the finalized route timeout recommendations and any routing fallback flags by EOD 2026-08-14 so I can ship the playbook v1.0.

Attached: I exported an initial owner map and a short agenda.

Ethan
Ethan Park
Developer Docs & Enablement
Redwood Inference
(attachment: doc-owners-tracker.xlsx)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staging-to-Prod sequence and enablement - RFI

Jordan / team —

CS notes on customer impact and communications:

- We have three customers who are high-risk for this cutover (Acme Inc., GreenShift, and BetaWorks). Anna Liu (anna@acme.com) is our primary contact for Acme and has asked for a heads-up 72h before their wave.
- Request: avoid scheduling Acme in the first 5% canary (they're on a rate-limited plan). Prefer Acme in wave 2 (25%).
- Blackout: Acme requests no maintenance windows on 2026-08-24–2026-08-26 due to an internal event; we'll encode that in the wave assignment spreadsheet.
- I'll share a prioritized outreach list by 2026-08-13 EOD. Also recommend we prepare an incident template for CS to use if customers report degraded latency post-cutover.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: partner-ops@cloudcorp.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 23:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staging-to-Prod sequence and enablement - RFI

Thanks for the quick replies — summary and next steps (please treat as decisions unless you object by EOD Friday 2026-08-13):

Decisions / assignments:
1) Cutover window confirmed: Primary 2026-08-22 02:00–08:00 UTC; fallback 2026-08-23 same window.
2) Waves: 5% (canary), 25%, 50%, 100% — timeline pinned in rollout-waves.csv. Grace flagged Acme -> move to wave 2.
3) Owners: Docs/Enablement (Ethan) owns playbook & training; Release Engineering (Monica) owns infra checklist & exceptions appendix; CS (Grace) owns customer outreach and incident template.
4) Exceptions: embedding cache TTL edge-case — Monica to add an appendix and a short rollback/fallback step. Also include request-timeout recommendations (Monica -> provide by 2026-08-14).
5) Training: Ethan to run two sessions (2026-08-17, 2026-08-19).

Actionables (owners + due dates):
- Monica: add exceptions appendix + route timeout recommendations (due 2026-08-14) -> JIRA INF-2345
- Ethan: playbook v1.0 + one-pager cheat sheet + slide deck (due 2026-08-16) -> Confluence draft link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cdE_staging-to-prod-plan
- Grace: prioritized customer outreach list + incident template (due 2026-08-13)
- Jordan: will coordinate the cutover dry run 2026-08-20 and confirm on-call rotations.

I'll update the playbook in Confluence and attach the final artifacts to the cutover Jira (INF-2345). If no flags from anyone, I'll mark these as committed tomorrow EOD.

Jordan Blake
Program Manager, Launch Operations
Redwood Inference
(related link: JIRA INF-2345; attachment: staging-cutover-playbook-v0.9.pdf, rollout-waves.csv)
